summary: Comprehensive test suite covering glob matching, rule configuration, label assignment, workflow structure, and end-to-end execution. Strong coverage of core requirements: glob patterns (literals, wildcards, **, basename-matching), multi-label assignment, priority ordering, config parsing, I/O formatting, and workflow validation. End-to-end testing through act harness captures and verifies exact output. Main gaps: GitHub Actions environment variable handling (GITHUB_OUTPUT, GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY) not tested; stdin input path untested; error cases not exercised through E2E pipeline; no error-path testing in act harness; conftest.py appears empty (no shared fixture infrastructure); Windows path handling implicit but not explicitly verified. Missing unicode/pathological pattern edge cases and performance testing. Would catch most regressions but could be more rigorous on integration details.
